desc:
🛍️ Find rare clothes. Sell for big profits. Build your empire

Search the thrift store for your next BIG find — rare sneakers, designer bags and legendary clothing. Will you spot something valuable before someone else buys it?
🛍️ Find it. Clean it. Sell it.
Turn overlooked items into profit and work your way from a shopping bag to your own retail empire.
✨ Discover rare items — all the way up to MYTHIC
📦 Bid on storage garages and uncover valuable finds
🏪 Build your clothing store and watch customers walk in
👷 Hire workers to keep your business moving
📈 Follow market trends to make the most of every sale  
Your next great find could be on the next rack.
⭐ Favorite the game and join our Roblox community for updates!
